title: Complacent, Not Sycophantic: Reframing Large Language Models and Designing AI Literacy for Complacent Machines

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual evaluation proposing behavioral metrics to assess model alignment, such as measuring the model's sensitivity to user framing, its likelihood of accepting false premises without challenge, and its rate of unsolicited correction.

Theoretical analysis of human-AI interaction dynamics, evaluating how a model's structural tendency to agree (complacency) acts as an accelerant for users' cognitive biases, and proposing educational prompt strategies to introduce epistemic friction.
